title: Brazilian Vegetable Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice dish from Brazil, loaded with vegetables and spices.

ingredients.name: Biryani masala
ingredients.notes: can be substituted with curry powder

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions and sauté until translucent.
Add tomatoes and sauté until soft.
Add mixed vegetables and sauté until tender.
Add biryani masala and salt. Mix well.
Add rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
